_comment: Only the RAG embedding model is configured here. Every chat/completion task is routed by litellm_config.yaml (model_name = task type) through app.services.llm_manager; per-user overrides live in MongoDB llm_preferences. Changing rag_embedding requires a full RAG index rebuild (rebuild_rag_index.py).

rag_embedding.description: Embedding models for the concept-based RAG index (data/rag_index_concepts)
rag_embedding.note: DO NOT change models/dimensions without rebuilding the FAISS index - queries must use the model the index was built with (index_info.json embedding_model). text-embedding-004 was retired by Google (404 since 2026); gemini-embedding-001 is truncated to 768 dims and L2-normalized.
